{{note|ambassador|1}} There was a duel before the ambassador's meeting. The winner of the challenge would be immune at the<br />next Tribal Council. Christina won this challenge.<br />
{{note|ambassador2|2}} At the ambassador's meeting, Christina and Taïg had to vote on one castaway to eliminate. They both<br />decided to vote out Gwendal.<br />
{{note|final5|3}} At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Linda and Coumba came<br />in last and were eliminated.
